policy.authorization: User requested automatic links for all Gondi Dialect Survey forms with an existing DEDR Gondi comparandum, followed by manual review of the remainder. This replaces the batch-by-batch approval gate for this pass.
policy.matching: Existing Jambu homepage fetchLemmaList inventory (115 pages, 5731 Gondi DEDR records), compatible senses checked against primary prose, normalized spelling matches, previous source-verified form groups, and inspected close forms/ordinary inflections. Fuzzy similarity was candidate discovery only.
policy.normalization: For matching only: lowercase, length/diacritic folding, central vowels to a, lax vowels to corresponding vowel, retroflex spelling to base letter (r and d remain distinct), nasal transcription folding, w/beta to v, phi to p, q to k, aspiration and gemination folding. Source transcriptions remain unchanged. Known ambiguities explicitly override normalization.
policy.exclusions: Questioned family placement, unresolved donor, mismatched sense, competing candidates, and unexplained or multi-part forms remain for manual review. Existing accepted batches were preserved.
